title: Pretraining Data Scale Reverses the Muon-AdamW Fine-Tuning Gap
abstract: arXiv:2611.03633v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Muon has recently emerged as a promising optimizer for pretraining large language models, offering a speedup over AdamW in minimizing pretraining loss. However, it remains unclear whether Muon's advantage persists after fine-tuning. In this paper, we study the downstream behavior of Muon and AdamW and uncover a surprising trend: beyond a sufficiently large pretraining data budget, AdamW outperforms Muon after fine-tuning. Moreover, as model size increases, AdamW overtakes Muon at progressively smaller pretraining token-parameter ratios. To explain this reversal, we view fine-tuning as a perturbation of the outputs and introduce the margin-to-spread ratio, which measures how far the correct logit lies above the wrong ones relative to how widely the wrong logits are spread. translated_title: 预训练数据规模逆转Muon与AdamW的微调差距
translated_abstract: Muon近来已成为一种有前景的大语言模型预训练优化器，在最小化预训练损失方面比AdamW提供了加速。然而，Muon的优势在微调之后能否持续尚不清楚。本文研究了Muon和AdamW的下游行为，并揭示了一个令人惊讶的趋势：当预训练数据预算超过足够大的规模后，AdamW在微调后的表现优于Muon。此外，随着模型规模的增大，AdamW在越来越小的预训练token-参数比率下就会超越Muon。为了解释这种逆转，我们将微调视为对模型输出的一种扰动，并引入了“边际-散度比”这一指标，用于衡量正确logit高于错误logit的程度相对于错误logit散布范围的比值。在语言模型中，Muon在小数据预算下具有更大的边际-散度比，而AdamW在大数据预算下具有更大的边际-散度比，这与微调性能的趋势相吻合。
tldr: 本文发现预训练数据规模会逆转Muon与AdamW优化器的微调性能差距——当预训练数据足够大时，微调后AdamW反而优于Muon，并提出了“边际-散度比”指标来解释这一逆转现象。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that pretraining data scale reverses the fine-tuning gap between Muon and AdamW—beyond a sufficiently large pretraining data budget, AdamW outperforms Muon after fine-tuning, and introduces the margin-to-spread ratio to explain this reversal.
